about: Other Ark checks the visual CI runs after the golden shots (docs/ark/visual-ci.md#hooks). A hook runs only when every file in `requires` exists, so a lane adds its entry here and it switches on when its code lands. A hook fails the job when its command exits non-zero; `artifacts` are uploaded with the shots. The behaviour audit (problems 1-7), the reactive encounters and the spawn validator run in their own job: .github/workflows/ark-behaviour-audit.yml, thresholds in tests/ark-audit/thresholds.json.

hooks.name: scenery checks and numbers (tree overlaps, props floating or in each other, the mountain's rocks)
hooks.command: npx tsx --test src/lib/ark-scenery.test.ts && mkdir -p .ark-golden/ci/scenery && npx tsx scripts/ark-scenery-metrics.mts --json .ark-golden/ci/scenery/metrics.json
